blocks.text: 🪝 MDoNER & Meghalaya Launch 'Mission Golden Spice' for Lakadong Turmeric (₹175.45 Crore). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Scales world's highest naturally occurring curcumin turmeric to a ₹100 crore economy by FY29.
Outlay & Roadmap: ₹175.45 crore 5-year convergence project (2025-2030) under 'Unlock Economic Potential of Northeast'.
Cultivation Target: Triples cultivation area to 7,000 hectares, benefiting 17,500 farmers (99% women) in Jaintia Hills.
Lakadong cultivation target (7,000 hectares) vs target Lakadong economy by FY29 (₹100 crore).
